```yaml
name: Test FATFS support

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test-fatfs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install build tools and utilities
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential mtools

      - name: Build wolfSSH and wolfsftp
        run: |
          make

      - name: Create FATFS image and test file
        run: |
          # Create a 10MB FAT filesystem image
          dd if=/dev/zero of=fatfs.img bs=1M count=10
          mkfs.vfat fatfs.img
          # Mount the image, create a test file, then unmount
          sudo losetup -fP fatfs.img
          LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j fatfs.img | cut -d: -f1)
          sudo mount $LOOPDEV /mnt
          echo "Hello, FATFS!" > /mnt/testfile.txt
          sudo umount /mnt
          sudo losetup -d $LOOPDEV

      - name: Prepare SSH key for authentication
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 2048 -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa -N ""
          cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys

      - name: Start wolfSSH server
        run: |
          # Create a minimal config file
          cat > server.conf <<EOF
          Port 2222
          AuthorizedKeysFile ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
          EOF
          # Start the server in the background
          ./wolfssh -p 2222 -d -c server.conf &
          echo $! > /tmp/wolfssh.pid
          # Give the server a moment to start
          sleep 5
        shell: bash

      - name: Run wolfsftp client to download test file
        run: |
          # Download the file from the server into the FATFS image
          # Mount the image again for the client to write into
          sudo losetup -fP fatfs.img
          LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j fatfs.img | cut -d: -f1)
          sudo mount $LOOPDEV /mnt
          # Use the client to download the file
          ./wolfsftp -p 2222 -l root -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa -c /mnt/testfile.txt testfile.txt
          # Unmount after download
          sudo umount /mnt
          sudo losetup -d $LOOPDEV
        shell: bash

      - name: Verify downloaded file
        run: |
          # Mount the image to read the downloaded file
          sudo losetup -fP fatfs.img
          LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j fatfs.img | cut -d: -f1)
          sudo mount $LOOPDEV /mnt
          # Compare the original and downloaded contents
          if cmp -s /mnt/testfile.txt /mnt/testfile.txt; then
            echo "File contents match."
          else
            echo "File contents do not match!" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          # Clean up
          sudo umount /mnt
          sudo losetup -d $LOOPDEV
        shell: bash

      - name: Stop wolfSSH server
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f /tmp/wolfssh.pid ]; then
            kill $(cat /tmp/wolfssh.pid) || true
          fi
```
